formNote: Message received through the website form:
private: Your address book is private: only the site team can see it.
emptyBook: Your address book is empty. Add a first person: a name is enough.
emptySearch: No card matches. Try another word, or remove a filter.
reviewBanner: This card comes from the website contact form. Check it, then say it is checked.
confirmAccountRemove: Remove this account from the card?
noAccounts: No account yet. Add one below.
helpHandle: Paste the profile address, or type the handle.
accountExisted: This account is already on the card.
errEmptyHandle: Paste a link or type a handle.
errWrongNetwork: This is a {network} link: choose « {network} » in the Network list.
errHandle_twitch: This is not a Twitch channel. Paste the channel address (for example twitch.tv/name) or type the handle (4 to 25 letters, digits or _).
errHandle_youtube: This is not a YouTube channel. Paste the channel address (for example youtube.com/@name), not a video's.
errHandle_tiktok: This is not a TikTok account. Paste the profile address (for example tiktok.com/@name) or type @name.
errHandle_instagram: This is not an Instagram account. Paste the profile address (for example instagram.com/name) or type the name.
errHandle_discord: Type the Discord username (for example player.name) or paste a discord.gg/… invite.
errHandle_x: This is not an X account. Paste the profile address (for example x.com/name) or type @name (15 characters at most).
errHandle_bluesky: This is not a Bluesky account. Type the name (for example name.bsky.social) or paste the bsky.app/profile/… address.
errHandle_mastodon: Write the full Mastodon account, with its server: @name@server.social, or paste the profile address.
errHandle_web: Paste a complete website address, for example https://www.mysite.com.
errTaken: This account is already on the card « {name} ». Open it to remove the account, or merge both cards.
errTooManyAccounts: This card already has 20 accounts: remove one first.
suggestTwitch: shows the photo and follower count of your contacts' Twitch accounts
suggestYoutube: shows the photo and subscriber count of your contacts' YouTube channels
othersHelp: This text was written before structured accounts. It stays as it is; the accounts found in it can be added in one click.
photoHelp: Without a chosen image, the photo comes from the account with the most followers.
photoInvalid: This image cannot be used: upload an image from your device, or paste an https address.
name: Name
helpOrganisation: Type its name: the organisation's card is created if it does not exist yet.
helpRelation: How you know each other, in a few words.
helpNewCategory: It is created and added to this card in one go.
emailInvalid: This e-mail address is incomplete: write it like name@example.com.
emailTaken: This address is already on another card.
bookFull: The address book is full (100,000 cards). Delete useless cards before adding new ones.
movedTo: This card was merged into another one.
openMoved: Open the card that was kept
busy: The address book is getting ready. Try again in a few seconds.
hiddenContact: E-mails and phone numbers only show with the « see e-mails and phone numbers » right.
noMembers: Nobody is linked to this organisation yet.
deleteHelp: This is final: the card and its notes disappear. The other modules that mention it are told.
confirmDeleteContact: Delete this card and its notes? This is final.
deletedSilent: Card deleted. Did not answer in time: {modules} (their reference may remain).
categoriesHelp: A category groups cards (for example « Raid target »). A card can have several.
confirmCatDelete: Delete this category? The cards are not deleted.
catInvalid: Write a name of 1 to 100 characters.
catTooMany: The address book already has 500 categories.
catMergeHelp: « {name} » disappears: its cards join the chosen category. The cards are not deleted.
catMerged: Done: the cards joined the other category.
catDeleted: Category deleted. The cards are not deleted.
catDenied: Your role does not allow creating categories.
catDeleteHelp: The cards are not deleted: they only lose this category.
catCardFull: This card already has 50 categories: remove one first.
catCardNoneYet: No category exists yet. Create one in the tab
photoUnchanged: Nothing changed: everything is already up to date.
photoMissing: For {services}, install the module that talks to that service (see the suggestion above).
photoFail: Could not reach {services} right now. The card keeps its latest data; try again in a few minutes.
photoNothing: This card has no Twitch, YouTube or Bluesky account to refresh.
privacyHelp: Download everything the site knows about this person (their card, notes and what the other modules keep), or erase them everywhere.
privDownload: Download everything the site knows about this person
privEraseExplain: {name}'s card, accounts and notes will be erased from this address book.
privEraseModules: These modules are also asked to erase what they keep about this person:
privEraseNoModules: No other module keeps a reference to this person.
privEraseFinal: This is permanent: there is no going back.
privEraseKeep: To keep a copy, download their data first (button below).
privEraseCheckError: Tick the box to confirm: erasing is permanent.
eraseSilent: {name}: did not answer in time (its reference may remain).
privReportHelp: What each module did. These reports do not contain people's names; the last 20 are kept.
privReportAlone: Only the address book card was erased: no other module kept a trace.
privReportWarn: At least one module did not answer in time: its reference to this person may remain. Open that module to check.

expIntro: One CSV file with every card (up to 100,000), to open in a spreadsheet. It has the same columns as the import: you can import it back as it is. Each card keeps its last 50 notes in it (the site backup holds them all).
expNoRight: Your role cannot export the address book. Ask the site owner for the “export the address book” right.
expContactHidden: E-mails and phone numbers will not be in the file: your role is not allowed to see them.
impIntro: A spreadsheet (CSV) with one row per person or organisation. Only the name is required. You see a preview before anything is added, and importing the same file again creates no duplicate: cards that already exist are completed, never renamed.
impColumns: Columns understood: name, type, role, organisation, email, phone, accounts, categories, notes. An account is written network:handle (twitch:jane_example | youtube:@jane) or pasted as a profile link; categories are separated by “|”. Other columns are ignored.
impTemplate: Download a template to fill in
impPasteHelp: The first row gives the column names. Example: name,accounts,categories. For a big file, use the field below instead.
impFileHelp: CSV or text file, 5 MB at most. If chosen, it replaces the pasted text.
impStaged: {count} rows read. Here is the preview: nothing is added yet.
impErrEmpty: Paste some rows or choose a file. Example of a first row: name,accounts,categories
impErrHeader: I do not recognise any column in the first row{found}. Start with a row of titles, for example: name,accounts,categories (or download the template above).
impErrQuote: A quote is not closed on row {record}. Add the missing quote, or remove that one.
impErrTooMany: This file has more than {max} rows, which is more than the address book can hold. Split it into several files and import them one after the other.
impErrNoRows: I see no row under the titles. Add at least one person, for example: Jane Example,twitch:jane_example
impErrBusy: An import is already running. Finish it or cancel it (higher on this page) before starting another.
impStepDone_previewing: Checking moved on: continue to finish it.
impStepDone_previewed: Check finished: here is the preview.
impStepDone_running: Import moved on: continue to finish it.
impPreviewHelp: Nothing has been added yet. Look at the numbers and rows below, then import.
impDoneHelp: Done. Rows with an error were not imported.
impErrorsHelp: Rows with an error will not be imported. Download them, fix them in your spreadsheet, then import the fixed file: rows already imported will not be duplicated.
impCancelConfirm: Cancel this import? Cards already created stay; the rest is forgotten.
impNoJob: There is no import in progress any more. Start again with your file.
impWorking: Another tab is already working on this import. Wait a few seconds, then reload the page.
impLinkedFile: completes row {line} of the same file ({changes})
impSkipped: already in the book, nothing to add
impTruncated: Only {shown} rows out of {count} are detailed here.
impE_unknown: Row {line}: this row could not be read.
impE_name: Row {line}: the name is missing, and there is no account to guess it from. Example: Jane Example, or twitch:jane_example.
impE_kind: Row {line}: the type “{value}” is not understood. Write person or organisation.
impE_status: Row {line}: the status “{value}” is not understood. Write checked or to review (or leave it empty).
impE_email: Row {line}: the e-mail “{value}” is not complete. Write it like jane@example.com.
impE_account_network: Row {line}: “{value}”: the network is not clear. Write the network first, for example twitch:jane_example or youtube:@jane, or paste the profile link.
impE_account_handle: Row {line}: “{value}” is not a valid account. {hint}
impE_too_many_accounts: Row {line}: {value} accounts, but a card keeps 20 at most. Keep the most useful.
impE_too_many_categories: Row {line}: too many categories ({value}); a card keeps 50 at most. Keep the most useful.
impE_too_many_notes: Row {line}: {value} notes, but 50 at most per row. Keep the most recent.
impE_note_long: Row {line}: a note is longer than {value} characters. Shorten it.
impE_photo: Row {line}: the photo address “{value}” must start with https://. Example: https://example.com/jane.jpg
impE_columns: Row {line}: {value} cells instead of {width}. A text containing the separator must be wrapped in quotes ("like this").
impE_accounts_two: Row {line}: these accounts are already on two different cards (“{a}” and “{b}”). First merge those two cards in the Duplicates tab.
impE_account_elsewhere: Row {line}: the account {value} is already on the card “{a}”. Remove it from this row, or merge the cards in the Duplicates tab.
impE_email_kind: Row {line}: the e-mail {value} is already on the card “{a}”, which is not the same type (person or organisation). Fix the type or the e-mail.
impE_too_many: Row {line}: the address book is full (100,000 cards). Delete cards you do not need before continuing.
impE_category_denied: Row {line}: the category “{value}” does not exist, and your role cannot create categories. Create it first in the Categories tab, or ask for the “create categories” right.
impE_category_limit: Row {line}: the address book already has 500 categories, “{value}” cannot be created. Reuse an existing category.
impE_vanished: Row {line}: the card was deleted during the import. Start the import again.
dupIntro: The address book spots cards that look alike (same account, same e-mail, same name in the same organisation…). You decide: nothing is merged without your agreement.
dupNone: No duplicate found. The address book is clean.
dupTruncated: There are many: the first 5,000 groups are listed. Sort these out and the list will update.
dupReason_name_close: Almost the same name, same organisation
mgCompareHelp: Choose the card to keep: the other one is merged into it (its accounts, categories and notes move to the kept card, its empty fields are filled in). You will see the details before confirming.
mgGone: One of the two cards no longer exists. Go back to the list of duplicates.
mgKindMismatch: A person and an organisation cannot be merged.
mgPicked: Here are the details of the merge.
mgMerged: Card merged into it, then deleted:
mgSkipFull: Will not move (the kept card already has 20 accounts): {account}.
mgSkipTaken: Will not move (this account is already on another card): {account}.
mgTakeMembers: {count} person(s) of this organisation move to the kept card.
mgTellModules: The other modules (Partnerships, Raid, Story…) are told and then point to the kept card.
mgIrreversible: Once confirmed, it is permanent. As long as you do not confirm, nothing changes: you can cancel.
mgDone: Cards merged. The other modules were told.
mgDoneSilent: Cards merged. Did not answer in time: {modules} (it will fix itself next time it is opened).
mgIgnored: Noted: these two cards will not be suggested again.
mgIgnoreFull: The list of set-aside pairs is full (20,000).
impStaging: The file was not fully read (the site may have restarted). Cancel this import and start again with your file.
impE_email_elsewhere: Row {line}: the e-mail {value} is already on the card “{a}”, while the accounts of this row are on another card. Fix the e-mail or the account, or merge the two cards in the Duplicates tab.
impKept: (the address book keeps its own values: {fields}).
